headlines.title: Israeli far-right minister calls for annexation of South Litani area
Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
'Will Deter Enemy From War': Israel Minister Calls For Lebanon, Gaza Takeover
South Lebanon children return to school destroyed by Israel strike
Aoun praises army for protecting all Lebanese 'even those against the state'

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite a ceasefire. [2]
An Israeli far-right minister has called for the annexation of the South Litani area. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR LEBANON
The Do Not Travel advisory for Lebanon reflects the security risks highlighted by Israeli military actions and political calls for annexation. [1][2][E2]

KEY RISKS
Lebanon's link to 363 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations as of Sep 28, 2026, poses a risk of further economic isolation amid ongoing conflict. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Lebanon, "Israel military action against Lebanon on September 28?", priced Yes at 92% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Sep 28, 2026. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Lebanon, "Israel withdraws from Lebanon by December 31, 2026?", priced Yes at 6% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E7]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the Israeli minister's call for annexation of the South Litani area leads to further escalation. [1]
